raw_sections.experience:
Experience
Senior Full-Stack Engineer – Sapiens (DigitalSuite R&D)
2023–Present
Agentic Platform Migration & Automation: Architected a Node.js/Claude migration platform to automate per-client portal customizations across 13+ enterprise insurance clients, reducing manual migration work performed by delivery teams of 8+ developers per client through classified playbooks and runtime tenant configuration.
Enterprise Identity & Auth Architecture: Architected a configuration-driven authentication platform using NextAuth, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, MongoDB, and AJV; unified Keycloak and Microsoft Entra ID with SSO, identity brokering, token lifecycle management, and federated logout across multi-tenant environments.
Design System & Platform Standardization: Established and drove adoption of a token-based design system across 3 engineering teams and 20+ developers; standardized primitive, semantic, and component-token patterns with CSS-variable theming and reusable React/Next.js platform components.
Supply-Chain Security & Platform Reliability: Owned production supply-chain security across shared platform packages; remediated npm CVEs, developed targeted patches, and drove dependency upgrades for core platform components.
AI-Enabled Dynamic UI Framework: Extended the core UI framework for AI-powered conversational rendering, enabling insurance information retrieved through LLM interactions to dynamically compose and render validated React components at runtime. 2020–2023
High-Scale Distributed Execution: Re-architected payroll workloads from AWS Batch to Node.js asynchronous workers and BullMQ; leveraged event-driven I/O for an I/O-intensive workload, scaling supported payroll processing from 10k to 80k+ employees while addressing database bottlenecks.
Kubernetes-Native Workload Platform: Architected and deployed a Kubernetes-native scheduling platform to replace AWS Batch during the organization’s migration away from AWS-managed execution; used Kubernetes Jobs for application-level scheduling, lifecycle management, retries, and scoped execution control.
ML Application Pipeline Architecture: Built SmartBook, a multi-model ML platform integrating Django, DRF, FastAPI, Pydantic, and Vue.js; decoupled synchronous web traffic from asynchronous model-processing pipelines.
Schema-Driven UI Engine: Developed an embeddable JSON Schema-based form engine using Vue.js and AJV; dynamically generated validated UIs integrated with background worker pipelines for asynchronous document generation. 2018–2019 Backend / Platform Engineer – ConnectWise
I/O Performance Engineering: Increased throughput of an I/O-intensive Python application using greenlet-based concurrency, improving I/O utilization without an architectural rewrite.
Identity & API Modernization: Designed automated Active Directory identity synchronization with a web portal using WSS, Flask, and a side-loaded C# Windows client; built an API translation layer mapping REST semantics to existing SOAP services without rewriting underlying business logic.
